During the period of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered several [[Noghri Death Commando]]s to the [[Yalara|planet Yalara]] to wipe out the primitive sentient native population, the [[Yalaran]]s, and guard the [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] that protected their planet. Years later, in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], these [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Mission to Yalara|were defeated]] by [[Jaden Korr]]<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> and the survivors were relocated to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].
